title: Keep ordinary fluctuations and speed-N rare laws distinct
statement: With phi(t,0)=0, unforced native martingale and the stated smaller observation envelope, arming is at most C exp(-c log^2 N). The same-record coupling preserves ordinary trajectories with this TV error while the speed-N current law changes. At the explicit native-only force port lim_N J_N(F)=0 for fixed F, while lim_N J_N prime(0)=D m(1-m)T>0. This is not equality of LDP actions from TV closeness or a violation of finite-system response theory.
